messages:
Sofia L.: Hi folks 1 Im starting the adoption process and expect a placement window in ~8-10 weeks. Im unclear on paperwork timelines: when should I formally request parental leave, and what documents does HR need for adoption?

People Ops - Priya: Congrats Sofia! For adoption we ask for a provisional notice ideally 30 days before your planned leave, but we can be flexible depending on placement unpredictability. Required docs: placement verification letter from agency or court paperwork once available, completed Parental Leave Request form, and adoption reimbursement forms if applicable.

Sofia L.: If placement is earlier than expected (could be within 2 weeks), can I file an emergency leave first and then amend to paid parental leave? How does that affect pay?

Michelle HR: Yes  you can take Emergency Dependent Care (EDC) or short unpaid leave initially, then submit an amendment to convert to company parental leave once placement docs arrive. Payroll note: conversions to paid parental leave are retroactive to the approved start date once docs are processed, but it can take one payroll cycle to reflect.

Benefits Bot: Adoption reimbursement: youre eligible for the adoption stipend up to the policy limit. Submit receipts within 180 days of placement. Stipend is paid as expense reimbursement, separate from payroll.

Sofia L.: What about health benefits continuation and retirement contributions during parental leave?

Benefits Bot: Company-paid health benefits continue for the duration of paid parental leave. If you take unpaid leave, you can elect COBRA or pay the employee portion via payroll deduction. 401(k) contributions stop during unpaid leave unless you make voluntary catch-up contributions later; employer match is handled per payroll rules.

Sofia L.: Are there any special visa/immigration forms or legal steps for international placements?

Legal - Omar: If adoption involves international travel or visa sponsorship, loop Legal early. We need to review travel authorization, any employer letter requests, and confirm time-off aligns with immigration timelines. Start a ticket with Legal and People Ops as soon as placement is probable.

Sofia L.: Good to know. One more practical question  does the parental leave start date count from the day of placement arrival or can I choose a later date within a short window?

People Ops - Priya: Parental leave start date can be the placement arrival day or any date you designate within 14 days of placement, as long as you notify HR and provide paperwork promptly. For payroll and accruals we treat the approved start date as the effective date for pay.

Payroll Bot: Payroll note: to ensure retroactive pay for any conversion from EDC/unpaid to paid parental leave, submit documents before payroll lock of the month following placement. Missing that window may delay adjustment by one additional cycle.

Sofia L.: Thanks all  this helps me plan. Priya  can you confirm the checklist and a preferred contact to DM when the agency calls?

People Ops - Priya: Sending checklist DM now and will be your point person. Checklist includes provisional notice template, Parental Leave Request form link, adoption stipend form, and guidance on payroll deadlines. DM me anytime. :heart:
